Copy Markdown Open POST / api / v2 / rodin Try in Playground Generate a 3D model and textures from images or a text prompt. Authorization Copy Anchor Link bearer header Authorization Bearer token Request Body Copy Anchor Link multipart/form-data body Image-to-3D body … TypeScript images * array unknown Copy Link Images to be used in generation, up to 5 images. As the form data request will preserve the order of the images, For Image-to-3D generation: required (one or more images are needed, maximum 5 images) For Text-to-3D generation: omit this field. Items 1 = items = 5 prompt ? string Copy Link A textual prompt to guide the model generation. For Image-to-3D generation: optional, provide orientation-level guidance (symmetric, sharp, detail...) for generation process For Text-to-3D generation: required. The prompt is first rendered to an image, so a text-only request can also be rejected with `IMAGE_CONTENT_VIOLATION`. Tips: it is recommended to omit this field for Image-to-3D generation. Length length = 1024 soft ? boolean Copy Link Optional. Appends smooth edges to the final geometry-generation prompt without changing the generation tier. Tips: We recommend leaving this parameter unset or omitting it entirely. Default false detail_level ? integer Copy Link Optional. Controls how many final geometry-refinement stages use RGB image conditioning. Higher values preserve more visual detail. Omit to use the default refinement path. Tips: We recommend leaving this parameter unset or omitting it entirely. Range 1 = value = 3 tier * string Copy Link Required. Select and explicitly send a Gen-2.5 tier. If omitted, the endpoint falls back to `Regular` and generates a Gen-1/1.5 asset. See [Tier](/en/api-specification/rodin-gen2-5#tier) for more information. This parameter may affect billing. See [Pricing](/en/api-specification/rodin-gen2-5#pricing). Default Regular Value in Gen-2.5-Extreme-Low Gen-2.5-Low Gen-2.5-Medium Gen-2.5-High Gen-2.5-Extreme-High mesh_mode ? string Copy Link Optional. Mesh topology of the generated model. `Raw` stands for Triangle face, `Quad` stands for Quad face. When omitted the default depends on `tier`: Gen-2.5 tiers default to `Raw`, every other tier defaults to `Quad`. Default Raw Value in Quad Raw quad_normal ? boolean Copy Link Optional. Bakes high-resolution geometry detail into a normal map during mesh refinement. Default false geometry_file_format ? string Copy Link Optional. Output geometry file format. Supported formats: `glb`, `usdz`, `fbx`, `obj`, and `stl`. Default glb Value in glb usdz fbx obj stl texture_mode ? string Copy Link Optional. Texture mode for the generated model. Higher modes generally produce richer, higher-resolution texture detail but take longer and may affect billing. See [Pricing](/en/api-specification/rodin-gen2-5#pricing). - `legacy`: Use the legacy texture pipeline. - `extreme-high`: Can produce up to 12K textures. See [Texture resolution](/en/api-specification/rodin-gen2-5#texture-resolution). The default value depends on the selected `tier`, see [Texture mode](/en/api-specification/rodin-gen2-5#texture-mode). Value in legacy extreme-low low medium high extreme-high material ? string Copy Link Optional. Material type. - `PBR`: Physically Based Materials, including base color texture, metallicness texture, normal texture and roughness texture, providing high realism and physically accurate response to dynamic lighting. - `Shaded`: Only base color texture with baked lighting, providing stylized visuals. - `All`: Both PBR and Shaded will be delivered. - `Hybrid`: PBR texture maps with a base color texture that includes baked lighting. - `None`: Asset without material. This will speed up generation. Default PBR Value in PBR Shaded All Hybrid None quality ? string Copy Link Optional. Preset target face count for Gen-2.5. Defaults to `medium`. The mapping depends on `mesh_mode`: - `Quad`: `high` 50000, `medium` 18000, `low` 8000, `extra-low` 4000; - `Raw`: `high` 1000000, `medium` 500000, `low` 60000, `extra-low` 20000. Default medium Value in high medium low extra-low quality_override ? integer Copy Link Optional. Custom target face count from 500 to 2000000 for Gen-2.5. Takes precedence over `quality` when present. `Gen-2.5-High` and `Gen-2.5-Extreme-High` support up to 2000000; all other Gen-2.5 tiers support up to 1000000. `Quad` mode has an additional maximum of 200000. Range 500 = value = 2000000 seed ? integer Copy Link Optional. A seed value for randomization in the mesh and texture generation. Range 0 = value = 65535 bbox_condition ? array integer Copy Link Optional. Controls the maximum dimensions of the generated model. Provide exactly three integers in Width (X-axis), Height (Y-axis), Length (Z-axis) order `(x, y, z)`. See [BBOX Control](/en/api-specification/bbox-control). Items 3 = items = 3 addons ? array HighPack Copy Link Optional add-on. Upgrades pack textures from 2K to 4K. For Gen-2.5, HighPack does not change geometry or generate an additional high-poly model. Default [] TAPose ? boolean Copy Link Optional. For a human-like subject, enables rest-pose conditioning so the result is generated in a T-pose or A-pose suitable for animation. When `false`, the input pose is reconstructed as-is. Default false use_original_alpha ? boolean Copy Link Optional. If `true`, preserves and uses the uploaded image alpha channel during image preprocessing. Has no effect when the input image has no alpha channel. Default false preview_render ? boolean Copy Link Optional. If true, provides an additional high-quality render image in the download list. Defaults to `false`. If use the [Fast mode](/en/api-specification/rodin-gen2-5#fast-mode), this parameter is ignored. Default false is_symmetric ? string Copy Link Optional. Intended symmetry of the generated geometry. Use `symmetric` for objects that should mirror left and right, `asymmetric` for posed or irregular objects, and `balanced` for mostly symmetric objects that should retain small natural differences. Use `unknown` to let the system infer the mode from the prompt and input images. Default unknown Value in symmetric balanced asymmetric unknown image_label ? array string Copy Link The viewing direction of each uploaded image, positionally matched to images. Entries default to ? (unknown) and the list is padded to the image count. Supplying more labels than images is rejected with IMAGE_LABEL_LENGTH_TOO_LONG. Support direction labels: - `Front`: `F` - `Front-Left`: `FL` - `Front-Right`: `FR` - `Back`: `B` - `Back-Left`: `BL` - `Back-Right`: `BR` - `Left`: `L` - `Right`: `R` - `Up`: `U` - `Down`: `D` - `Unknown`: `?` Default [] hd_texture ? boolean Copy Link Optional. Enables an additional texture super-resolution and enhancement pass. This can improve fine-detail clarity but may also introduce artifacts. It does not select the final 2K or 4K pack resolution; use the `HighPack` add-on for 4K output. Default false uhd_texture ? boolean Copy Link Default false is_micro ? boolean Copy Link Whether to generate micro-scale surface detail. Only allowed when `tier` is `Gen-2.5-Extreme-High`; any other tier is rejected with `INVALID_REQUEST`. Tips: We recommend leaving this parameter unset or set to default value. Default false geometry_instruct_mode ? string Copy Link Optional. Selects the geometry-generation strategy. `creative` favors richer or more imaginative structure with less strict input fidelity; `faithful` stays closer to the provided image and prompt, but may not always produce a closer match or higher-quality results. Availability depends on the selected `tier`. Tips: We recommend omitting this parameter to use the default value. `faithful` is an experimental option, may be discontinued in the future, and is not recommended for production use. Default creative Value in faithful creative texture_delight ? boolean Copy Link Optional. If `true`, removes highlights and baked lighting from texture-reference images before texture generation to reduce lighting artifacts in the generated material. Tips: We recommend leaving this parameter unset or omitting it entirely unless you have specific lighting requirements. Default false Response Body Copy Anchor Link 201 application/json response response … TypeScript error ? string Copy Link Error code, if the request could not be submitted. This is returned in the response body alongside HTTP 201, so clients must check this field rather than relying on the HTTP status alone. This field is omitted on success. - `API_NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION`: the account has no active subscription. - `API_SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN_TOO_LOW`: the subscription plan does not allow API access. - `API_PARALLELISM_LIMIT_REACHED`: too many tasks are already in flight for the account. - `API_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS`: the account balance is insufficient for the request. - `API_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND_ON_IMAGE`: no object was detected in the input image. - `INVALID_REQUEST`: the request is malformed, missing required parameters, or contains invalid values. Check `message` for additional information. - `IMAGE_LABEL_LENGTH_TOO_LONG`: more `image_label` entries than uploaded images. - `IMAGE_CONTENT_VIOLATION`: the input image violates content requirements. - `NO_SUCH_TASK`: the referenced task does not exist or has expired. - `ASSET_NOT_AVAILABLE`: the referenced asset is not in an operable state. - `PERMISSION_DENIED`: the authenticated user may not perform this action. - `API_UNKNOWN`: an unexpected error occurred. Check `message` for additional information. Value in NO_SUCH_TASK ASSET_NOT_AVAILABLE IMAGE_LABEL_LENGTH_TOO_LONG INVALID_REQUEST API_NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION API_SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN_TOO_LOW API_PARALLELISM_LIMIT_REACHED API_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS API_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND_ON_IMAGE IMAGE_CONTENT_VIOLATION PERMISSION_DENIED API_UNKNOWN message ? string Copy Link Success message or detailed error information. uuid ? string Copy Link Unique identifier for the submitted generation task. Format uuid submit_time ? string Copy Link Server time when the task was submitted. Format date-time jobs ? object Copy Link A job object, containing details of individual jobs executed as part of the generation process. consumed ? number Copy Link Credits consumed by this request. prompt ? string Copy Link The prompt actually used for generation. Example Request cURL Copy Text curl -X POST https://api.hyper3d.com/api/v2/rodin \ -F tier=Gen-2.5-Extreme-Low Example Response Schema 201 Copy Text { error : NO_SUCH_TASK , message : Submitted. , uuid : 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000 , submit_time : 2019-08-24T14:15:22Z , jobs : { uuids : [ 52faea01-729e-4195-85e8-6050a65315e3 ], subscription_key : string }, consumed : 0.5, prompt : string } Input Copy Anchor Link Image-to-3D Copy Anchor Link Submit one to five images . The first image is used for material generation. prompt is optional; when omitted, the service derives guidance from the images. Copy Text curl --fail-with-body --request POST https://api.hyper3d.com/api/v2/rodin \ --header Authorization: Bearer ${ RODIN_API_KEY } \ --form images=@./input.png \ --form tier=Gen-2.5-Medium \ --form mesh_mode=Raw \ --form quality=medium Text-to-3D Copy Anchor Link Submit a prompt and omit images . Copy Text curl --fail-with-body --request POST https://api.hyper3d.com/api/v2/rodin \ --header Authorization: Bearer ${ RODIN_API_KEY } \ --form prompt=A small wooden treasure chest with brass trim \ --form tier=Gen-2.5-Medium \ --form mesh_mode=Raw \ --form quality=medium Tier Copy Anchor Link tier is required Always send a Gen-2.5 tier explicitly. If tier is omitted, the endpoint falls back to Regular and generates a Gen-1/1.5 asset. tier selects the generation family and how much detail the model resolves. It is independent of the mesh and texture controls below: any tier can be combined with any mesh_mode , quality , or texture_mode the schema allows. Tier Intended use Gen-2.5-Extreme-Low Quick generation of simple assets. Gen-2.5-Low Clean assets and small hard-surface props. Gen-2.5-Medium Balanced structure and detail. Gen-2.5-High Richer structure and smoother surfaces. Gen-2.5-Extreme-High High-frequency detail reproduction. This tier also returns an additional mesh with up to 10M of faces. Geometry generation modes Copy Anchor Link geometry_instruct_mode selects how the input guides geometry generation. creative favors more flexible interpretation and is available for Gen-2.5-Medium and higher tiers. faithful emphasizes matching the image and prompt, though results vary. Experimental option: faithful faithful may be discontinued and is not recommended for production use. For routine generation, omit geometry_instruct_mode to use the default. Fast mode Copy Anchor Link When the submitted task meets all of the following conditions, Fast mode is triggered and resulting in faster generation. tier is not Gen-2.5-Extreme-High . geometry_file_format is glb \ fbx \ usdz . mesh_mode is Raw . quality_override = 20000. Texture mode Copy Anchor Link texture_mode selects the texture generation effort level. The default value of texture_mode depends on the selected tier . Tier Default texture_mode Gen-2.5-Extreme-Low extreme-low Gen-2.5-Low low Gen-2.5-Medium medium Gen-2.5-High high Gen-2.5-Extreme-High high Texture resolution Copy Anchor Link The texture resolution is jointly determined by texture_mode , uhd_texture , and addons . HighPack increases pack texture resolution as shown below. For Gen-2.5, it does not change geometry or generate an additional high-poly model. texture_mode addons uhd_texture resolution extreme-low, low, medium, high [] false 2K true 4K HighPack false 4K true 8K extreme-high [] false 6K true 6K HighPack false 12K true 12K Pricing Copy Anchor Link Item Charge Base Gen-2.5 generation 0.5 credits tier=Gen-2.5-Extreme-High +0.5 credits texture_mode=extreme-high +2.0 credits Charges are additive. Base generation costs only 0.5 credits , and parameters not listed above do not incur additional charges. Response and lifecycle Copy Anchor Link Copy Text { message : Submitted. , uuid : 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000 , jobs : { uuids : [ 223e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000 ], subscription_key : subscription-key-from-generation-response }, consumed : 0.5 } Use jobs.subscription_key for Check Status and top-level uuid for Download Results . HTTP 201 means the endpoint handled the request; acceptance requires an absent or empty error and a non-empty top-level uuid . HTTP 400 indicates invalid fields/files, 401 indicates invalid authentication, and 429 indicates throttling. Rodin Agentic Generate 3D assets from images with Rodin Agentic.
